items.difficulty_reason: The lemma collects four functorial properties of nonsingular projective models under field extension (statement lines 478-497). The proof (lines 499-535) is a four-part reference chain: birational reduction to the proper case (with a small birational-invariance detail the author marks omitted), properness of normalizations for (1), the purely inseparable improvement argument normal-regular-smooth for (2), and global-section plus base-change arguments for (3) and (4). The single omitted detail sits in the auxiliary reduction, not in any of the four conclusions. H2: standard assembly of earlier results with correctly ordered hinges.
